description: GIRA bike-sharing docking station data is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Empresa Municipal de Mobilidade e Estacionamento de Lisboa. GIRA Network Data. Statuses of individual Gira bike-sharing docking stations: desigcomercial (Name/Location, e.g., ""471 - Rua Lopes Mendonça/EB São João de Brito"", ""219 - Praça do Município"")numbicicletas (Number of bicycles currently docked: e.g., 7, 18)numdocas (Total dock capacity: e.g., 10, 22)numdocasvacias (Number of empty docks: e.g., 3, 4)estado (Status, e.g., ""active"")Geo-spatial coordinates in bbox, position ... Coverage: a single site or case study; the metadata date the deposit to 2018. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
